product_one_liner.value: Mimica is an AI process-intelligence platform that maps workflows and generates automation agents for large enterprises and their transformation teams.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link or plan page was found. The site directs visitors to a demo/contact form that offers to answer pricing questions.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in customer testimonials.

eng_blog.notes: The article index contains product announcements, business guidance and company news, rather than two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: No public product-documentation, help-center or developer-portal link was found in the site's navigation or footer; its guides are marketing resources.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: An open Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer posting includes an application link.

model_provider.notes: Its Forward Deployed Engineer posting names these models for enterprise AI-agent solutions; this is not an exclusive model inventory for every product.

compliance_certs.notes: Mimica explicitly claims compliance with both; GDPR is a regulatory compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 24, 2025, led by Paladin Capital Group.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 24, 2025 Series B falls within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An open Associate Business Development Representative posting includes an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Introduced Maker, an agentic automation platform, on September 30, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small published leadership section lists founders Tuhin Chakraborty (CEO) and Raphael Holca-Lamarre (CTO); no qualifying arrival or departure was found in the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting requires keeping Salesforce updated with account, deal-size and pipeline-status information.
